annotation.title_clean: חיזוק ההובלה הגלובלית של ההייטק הישראלי בעידן ה-AI: במקומות בהם מצויינות גוברת על גודל – חזון, יעדים וצעדים אופרטיביים
annotation.title_en: Strengthening the Global Leadership of Israeli High-Tech in the AI Era: Where Excellence Outweighs Scale – Vision, Goals and Operative Steps
annotation.summary_en: Draft strategy from the Israel Innovation Authority (April 2026) for industry comment, setting a vision and four axes (applications, AI enablers, technology/Physical AI, geopolitics) to keep Israeli high-tech globally leading in AI. Includes Physical AI and robotics test sites, regulatory sandboxes, and safety certification tracks for autonomous systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision: Israeli high-tech to lead globally in AI where excellence outweighs scale
Four axes: applications, AI enablers, Physical AI technology, geopolitics (Pax Silica)
Establish an applied research institute for Physical AI and test sites for Physical AI and robotics
Develop dedicated certification tracks for autonomous-systems safety and increase presence in international standards bodies
Sectoral regulatory sandboxes and dual-reality national projects modelled on the drone project
